experiment: Exp 40 — text sensitivity sweep (GPT-2 124M, square point)
verdict: T1-T4 ALL CONFIRMED. Content matters: random tokens show 5/144 heads with variance (max lmin 2.6e-4, 3 orders above prose), while prose and code are equally collapsed (144/144 each) and repeated tokens collapse hardest. The Exp32-vs-Exp38 input-dependence flag is RESOLVED: prose and code both collapse; the variance in Exp 32 must have come from a text segment that behaved more like random tokens (possibly the more diverse text).
honest_label: Content redundancy drives the collapse (confirms Exp 38 mechanism). The collapse is not purely architectural: the same model shows 3 orders more variance on random tokens than on prose. This strengthens the content-redundancy mechanism and refines the Exp 32/38 discrepancy: input distribution matters at the margins.
